# HeyReach CLI - Comprehensive Agent Reference Manual

> An exhaustive technical manual for autonomous agents driving the HeyReach CLI (`heyreach`). Covers all commands and endpoints for the HeyReach LinkedIn Outreach API.

## When To Use This Tool
- Automated LinkedIn outreach campaign orchestration (pause, resume, inspect).
- Programmatic lead ingestion from CSV/JSON data pipelines.
- Multi-sender account monitoring, connection discovery, and message delivery.
- Real-time webhook configuration for CRM synchronization.
- Automated outreach performance reporting and analytics extraction.

## Exit Codes and Error Envelopes

Every error response on stderr conforms to the standard envelope structure:
```json
{
  "error": "Human readable summary",
  "code": "error_code_string",
  "detail": "Extended debugging context or HTTP status body",
  "remediation": "Exact command or action needed to fix"
}
```

Exit code numbers match the error code contract:
- `0`: Success
- `1`: `error` - Unclassified or general error
- `2`: `network` - Transport failure, connection timeout, or 5xx server error
- `3`: `auth_required` - API key rejected, missing, or unauthorized
- `4`: `not_found` - Resource ID or endpoint does not exist
- `5`: `rate_limited` - API rate limit reached (HTTP 429)
- `6`: `invalid_input` - Bad command flags, missing arguments, or malformed JSON
- `7`: `no_account` - `--account <name>` not specified when multiple accounts exist

## All Commands Reference

### Authentication & Accounts
- `heyreach auth check [--api-key <key>] [-a <account>]`: Validates API key.
- `heyreach login [name] [--api-key <key>] [--api-key-stdin] [--no-browser] [--force] [--no-verify]`: Logs into account.
- `heyreach accounts add <name> [--api-key <key>] [--api-key-stdin] [--force] [--no-verify]`: Adds account.
- `heyreach accounts list [--check]`: Lists accounts.
- `heyreach accounts test <name>`: Tests account connectivity.
- `heyreach accounts remove <name> [--yes]`: Removes account.

### Campaigns
- `heyreach campaigns list [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>] [--status <active|paused|draft|completed>]`: List campaigns.
- `heyreach campaigns get <id>`: Get campaign details.
- `heyreach campaigns pause <id>`: Pause running campaign.
- `heyreach campaigns resume <id>`: Resume paused campaign.
- `heyreach campaigns add-leads <id> [--file <path>]`: Add array of leads.
- `heyreach campaigns stop-lead <campaign-id> --lead <lead-id>`: Stop specific lead.

### Lead Lists
- `heyreach lists list [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>]`: List lead lists.
- `heyreach lists get <id>`: Get list details.
- `heyreach lists create --name <name> [--type user|company]`: Create empty list.
- `heyreach lists leads <id> [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>] [--keyword <string>]`: Get leads in list.
- `heyreach lists add-lead <id> --linkedin-url <url>`: Add lead to list.
- `heyreach lists remove-lead <id> --lead <lead-id>`: Remove lead from list.
- `heyreach lists companies <id> [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>]`: Get companies in company list.

### Leads
- `heyreach leads get --linkedin-url <url>`: Get lead by profile URL.
- `heyreach leads lists --linkedin-url <url>`: Get lists containing lead.
- `heyreach leads update-status --lead <lead-id> --status <status>`: Update lead status (pending, contacted, replied, connected, not_interested, bounced).

### Sender Accounts
- `heyreach senders list [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>]`: List sender LinkedIn accounts.
- `heyreach senders get <id>`: Get sender details.
- `heyreach senders network <id> [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>]`: Get sender connections.

### Conversations
- `heyreach conversations list [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>] [--campaign-id <id>] [--sender-id <id>]`: List conversations.
- `heyreach conversations send --lead <lead-id> --message <text> [--sender-id <id>]`: Send message.

### Analytics
- `heyreach stats get [--from <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--to <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--campaign-id <id>] [--sender-id <id>]`: Get overall statistics.

### Webhooks
- `heyreach webhooks list [--limit <int>] [--offset <int>]`: List registered webhooks.
- `heyreach webhooks get <id>`: Get webhook details.
- `heyreach webhooks create --name <name> --url <url> --event <event> [--campaign-id <id>]`: Create webhook.
- `heyreach webhooks update <id> [--name <name>] [--url <url>] [--event <event>] [--active <true|false>]`: Update webhook.
- `heyreach webhooks delete <id>`: Delete webhook.

### Tags
- `heyreach tags create --name <name> [--color <hex>]`: Create tag.
